(rule!
  ;; Treat every nonzero, non-marker cell as foreground so a target may contain
  ;; multiple colors while remaining one 4-connected component.
  (let* ((marker (first (find-color g 8)))
         (mask (cellmap g (r c v)
                 (if (or (= v 0) (= v 8)) 0 1)))
         (components (map obj-cells (objects mask 0)))
         ;; The key relation is CARDINAL adjacency. Diagonal proximity is a
         ;; distractor and must not depend on component discovery order.
         (target (first
                  (filter
                   (lambda (cells)
                     (any? (lambda (p)
                             (= (+ (abs (- (first p) (first marker)))
                                   (abs (- (second p) (second marker))))
                                1))
                           cells))
                   components)))
         (bb (bbox-of-cells target))
         (r0 (first bb))
         (c0 (second bb))
         (r1 (third bb))
         (c1 (fourth bb)))
    ;; Render only target cells into the crop. A marker or distractor that lies
    ;; inside a concavity of the target bbox is not part of the answer.
    (upscale
     (grid-from-fn (+ 1 (- r1 r0)) (+ 1 (- c1 c0))
       (lambda (r c)
         (let ((rr (+ r r0)) (cc (+ c c0)))
           (if (member? (list rr cc) target) (at g rr cc) 0))))
     2)))
